construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored inside this isolated build directory.

shared_schema.input: schema_version, synthetic=true, timezone-aware as_of, documents[id,category,text,popularity], events[document_id,kind,at], behavior[top_k,half_life_days,purchase_weight], extraction_schema[name,pattern,type,required], research[queries,max_findings]. All keys are required; unknown keys are rejected.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic, status=ok, behavior[cold_start,ranking], extraction[documents], research[queries]. Errors: status=error,error with exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: The shared Validator checks input and producer/consumer boundaries, unique IDs, dates, numbers, rank membership/order, field partition/completeness, typed values, original source spans, research citations and extraction evidence links.
shared_schema.source_span: document_id,start,end,quote; zero-based half-open Unicode character offsets into original document text.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated behavior ranking exclusively selects and orders extraction documents; unranked documents cannot enter extraction.
Validated extracted field spans restrict research to selected documents and passages containing at least one complete extracted field span. Evidence field names accompany findings.

behavior.personalization: Event weight = (purchase_weight for purchase, 1 for browse) * 2^(-age_days/half_life_days). Document score = direct event weight sum + 0.25 * same-category event weight sum. Cold start or fully underflowed history uses popularity. Descending score then ascending document ID breaks ties.
behavior.extraction: Trusted multiline regex patterns require named group value. First match only; strip outer whitespace while preserving adjusted source offsets. Supported string, integer and strict ISO date conversion. Missing fields include not_found, empty_value or invalid_value and required flags. Missing required fields mark incomplete but do not discard valid evidence.
behavior.research: Nonblank lines are exact source passages. Unicode casefolded lexical query coverage ranks passages with extraction evidence; ties follow personalized document order and source offset. Empty lexical queries/no overlap produce no findings. Findings are verbatim passages, not generated summaries.
behavior.determinism: Time comes only from input as_of; no random, wall-clock ranking, network or model calls.

included: Single integrated local pipeline with shared validation
Typed extraction, missing-field reporting and exact citations
Standard-library unittest and subprocess CLI checks
excluded: Live model providers or optional model hooks
Semantic embeddings, generative synthesis or external research
Multi-user identity, persistent profiles, production infrastructure
Untrusted regex execution guarantees; schemas are trusted local configuration
Nested PDF/HTML extraction, cross-line passage evidence and multi-value fields
scope.administrative_note: A required local prompt audit log is stored separately at docs\My_prompt.txt; it is not a runtime deliverable.

test_outcomes.cli_example_stdout: One JSON object with status=ok and validated behavior, extraction and research sections.
test_outcomes.error_cli_checks: Missing file, wrong argument count and schema-invalid file return JSON status=error, exit 2; decoder and Unicode errors are also covered.
